cards.name: Azra Bladeseeker
cards.oracleText: When this creature enters, each player on your team may discard a card, then each player who discarded a card this way draws a card.

cards.name: Azra Smokeshaper
cards.oracleText:
Ninjutsu {1}{B} ({1}{B}, Return an unblocked attacker you control to hand: Put this card onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.)
When this creature enters, target creature you control gains indestructible until end of turn.

cards.name: Azra Matchthrower
cards.oracleText:
Battlebond (You may pair this creature with an unpaired battle you control when either enters the battlefield. They remain paired for as long as you control both of them.)
As long as Azra Matchthrower is paired with a battle, each of those permanents has "Whenever this permanent is dealt combat damage, this permanent deals 1 damage to any target."

cards.name: Azra Oddsmaker
cards.oracleText: At the beginning of combat on your turn, you may discard a card. If you do, choose a creature. Whenever that creature deals combat damage to a player this turn, you draw two cards.
